morgan-stanley.summary: The Morgan Stanley and MUFG Japan Summit 2026 highlighted governance reform, macro themes, and retail flows in Japan, with a positive outlook on Japanese equities, neutral on private CapEx, and cautious on oil markets.

run_summary.overall_day_summary: Market watchers are optimistic about Japanese equities due to governance reform driving capital optimization and growth. There is a neutral view on private CapEx and a cautious stance on oil markets. Retail savings mobilization through changes to NISA savings accounts could support domestic equity flows.
top_claims_worth_watching: Changes to NISA savings accounts could mobilize Japan's retail savings, supporting domestic equity flows.
